profile.headline: Business Analyst, Project Manager, and Drupal Developer
profile.jobTitle: Business Analyst, Assistant Project Manager, and Frontend Developer
profile.summary:
At Peraton, contributed as a Systems Engineer Principal Technical Specialist, leveraging over 15 years of expertise in website administration, web content management, and web application development. Led a team of 20 developers in the continuous development and support of the IRS's Drupal 10 website, focusing on optimizing performance, scalability, and user engagement.  

Prior experience includes the migration of multiple state and federal agency websites to Drupal and serving as a senior Drupal developer for multiple IRS websites. Demonstrating a mission-driven approach to delivering reliable, high-performance web solutions for enterprise-scale platforms. Fueled by a commitment to collaboration and innovation, excels in managing complex projects and aligning technical capabilities with organizational goals.

positions.title: VP - Capital Markets
positions.description:
Initially I was hired as a Systems Administrator but over the course of the 3 plus years I was with this company I became heavily involved in the financial side and eventually was promoted to an executive position that was responsible for both managing the IT department as well as being in charge of financial dealings on the secondary market.  

On a monthly basis I prepared the highly detailed financial documentation that estimated the current market value (retail and wholesale) of our portfolio of asset backed securities (equipment leases). This documentation was utilized by our creditor and business partner (Lehman Brothers) to ensure that the value of these assets exceeded the amount borrowed on our 75 million dollar warehouse line. In addition to monthly financial reports I also negotiated and prepared for the sale of large portions (3 to 15 million dollars) of our portfolio to other wholesale lenders. The completion of these duties required an excellent understanding of the math involved, knowledge of the databases where this information was stored (btrieve & access), Crystal Reports, Visual Basic and Excel.

Our IT department consisted of Microsoft NT Server 4, Exchange Server, IIS, Nortel Phone System, Right Fax Server, Great Plains Accounting System and at times up to 120 windows client workstations. I managed three employees, a desktop technician, a network administrator and a secretary to handle the phones and filing related to my financial analysis work.

experience.title: VP - Capital Markets
experience.description:
Initially I was hired as a Systems Administrator but over the course of the 3 plus years I was with this company I became heavily involved in the financial side and eventually was promoted to an executive position that was responsible for both managing the IT department as well as being in charge of financial dealings on the secondary market.  

On a monthly basis I prepared the highly detailed financial documentation that estimated the current market value (retail and wholesale) of our portfolio of asset backed securities (equipment leases). This documentation was utilized by our creditor and business partner (Lehman Brothers) to ensure that the value of these assets exceeded the amount borrowed on our 75 million dollar warehouse line. In addition to monthly financial reports I also negotiated and prepared for the sale of large portions (3 to 15 million dollars) of our portfolio to other wholesale lenders. The completion of these duties required an excellent understanding of the math involved, knowledge of the databases where this information was stored (btrieve & access), Crystal Reports, Visual Basic and Excel.

Our IT department consisted of Microsoft NT Server 4, Exchange Server, IIS, Nortel Phone System, Right Fax Server, Great Plains Accounting System and at times up to 120 windows client workstations. I managed three employees, a desktop technician, a network administrator and a secretary to handle the phones and filing related to my financial analysis work.
